description: Bounded public disposition for the Alice-campaign negative results: the Laya/System-1 decision sidecar (38.4% agreement against an 84.9% constant baseline), the closed 100k raw-decode target and the closed structured-sparsity lever, the retired ALICE_MOE_BLOCK lane, the F2 copy-stream null, the CPU-MoE prefill regression, the memory-infeasible coarse double staging, and the campaign's internal retractions. The executing runtime tree, model weights, container bytes, and raw receipts are excluded from publication; values below are sanitized summaries of campaign-local receipts.
model_revision: campaign artifacts; no weight payload is part of this repository
model_download_source: not applicable to negative results; no weight payload is part of this repository
hardware_phenotype: RX9060XT16-NITRO-GFX1200-RADV-2026.08.27-v1; RX 9060 XT 16 GB, gfx1200; ROCm/HIP and Vulkan builds
gpu_configuration: RX 9060 XT 16 GB, gfx1200; ROCm/HIP and Vulkan builds
prompt: not applicable; these are rejections and retractions

expected_range.laya_outcome: model, checkpoint, and dependencies removed; receipt retained
expected_range.target_100k_raw_decode: CLOSED (676.9 op-TOPS required vs a 590-630 band; 18.0-20.25 GiB vs an 11.38 GiB budget)
expected_range.structured_sparsity: CLOSED (1.90-2.10x on the same logical GEMM; 563-637 credited op-TOPS against 821; loses 1.56x to eligible dense 2-bit)
expected_range.wide_mtp_verifier: DIMINISHING (wide-M bandwidth 197 -> 184 -> 164 -> 129 GB/s as M goes 1 -> 5)

tolerance.not_applicable: negative results carry the instrument reading, not a tolerance band

known_limitations: These are rejections of specific implementations and configurations, not proofs of impossibility, except where the direction is closed by physics and labelled as such.
The Laya model and its dependencies were deliberately removed; only the receipt remains.
A negative result is not evidence that a different mechanism would also fail.
